content: Claude Code marketplace: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at repo root {name (kebab), owner{name,email?,url?}, metadata.pluginRoot?, plugins[{name, source, description?, version?}]}; source forms: './relative/path' (same repo), {source:'github',repo,ref,sha}, {source:'url',url}, {source:'git-subdir',url,path,ref}, {source:'npm',package,version}, {source:'archive',url,sha256}, {source:'command'}. Users: /plugin marketplace add owner/repo then /plugin install name@marketplace.
